items.what_happened: The player's 12:06 list step 'armadvsol home #as6'. At 13:14 (60%) the list queued its next step behind the frame ('help build #as5'). At 13:28 (f24246) armadvsol_12737, another builder's frame 200 away at (1168,5248), finished. Nine frames later (f24255) the hands sent constructor_18284 to guard constructor_30757, the queued help, and its own frame stood at 77%. The hands' finished-event handler ends a builder's started build, or promotes its queued task, for any finished unit of the same type within 250 of the build (pianist/mod.rs Event::UnitFinished), so the neighbour's finish was taken as this builder's. The builder then took the player's 13:39 armmakr list (13:47), nobody came back, and the frame decayed over 100 s.
evidence: 13:14 (list) help build #as5 (next, queued: help constructor_30757 build)
13:28 f24246 ev finished armadvsol_12737 at (1168,5248), 200 from the frame; f24255 cmd ['guard', 18284, 30757]; last progress 13:29
pianist/mod.rs Event::UnitFinished: builders whose Task::Build has def == finished def, started, near.dist2d(pos) < 250 -> take_queued, else the task is removed

items.what_happened: An engine-queued solar that the hands had lost track of. At 9:00 the nano frame armnanotc_27075 (the replaced order's frame) was taken as the new solar task's frame: the created-event handler marks the builder's Build task started on any frame it makes (9:02 report: 'building a Solar Collector (armsolar) at plant2_east (C7) (not yet started)'). The 60% queue-ahead therefore fired at 9:32 on a build not begun and queued a solar at C7 (2360,5096). The real frame at 9:47 was read as that queued build beginning, so when it finished at 10:14 the task ended while the engine still held the C7 order. From 10:15 the entry read 'finishing an order'. The 10:11 list (#as2, #as4) could neither drop that order nor play its own steps, because the builder never stood idle. The engine walked the builder to C7 and laid the frame at 10:32. The builder walked off it 10:34-10:41 with no command and no enemy near, then came back and restarted the same site at 10:47 (armsolar_23071, finished 11:16).

mechanisms: The hands' finished-event match by type and radius (pianist/mod.rs Event::UnitFinished: any started build of the same type within 250 of a finished unit is ended or has its queued task promoted) took a neighbour's finished frame as the builder's own: armadvsol_12108 (270 metal; the builder was sent to its queued help at 77%) and armsolar_25985 (82; the build vanished from the report and from the pick's words 25 s before the player's stop). Matching the builder's own frame by unit id would have kept the 270; 25985 the player dropped anyway.

Re-lists headed by `stop` over started frames: armsolar_26962 (133; reported at 55%, its builder walled in, so the new step could never be reached) and armsolar_25985 (82; its share hidden by the first mechanism). A queue result naming the share it drops, or a `stop` that spares the frame a stuck builder stands at, would have kept up to 215.

Lone raiders on frames where the answer the packet asked for did not land: armsolar_26776 (37; 'the commander attacks a lone armflea at spot_73' rated 0.25-0.49 and never picked), armllt_23066 (20; a 0.02-confidence pick walked the home guard group_T1 off its armham hunt) and armmex_31508 (17; a far spot with no turret, the hunters 2,000-3,300 away): 74 metal.
